label: Late-episode D2 at S2 after a common a2 choice following an unrewarded trial (switch-to/against-good a2)
explanation: Fires only at D2, only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 via the common transition (in_action=2, in_state=2: 100% of activations). It never fires at D1 or GO, nor at S1 or after rare transitions. It needs the previous trial to be unrewarded (97% of mass) and is confined to the late episode (ep_trial >= 60, mostly 80-99), with low model value (all activations are in the bottom ~40% of value). Those three conditions alone give recall 0.92 and mass recall 0.96 but precision only 0.26. Within that set it fires most often, and most strongly, when a2 was a switch (stay == 0, precision 0.84 alone) or when S1 is actually the good state (choosing a2 goes against the good state). Adding that pair of conditions gives dev F1 0.58 and mass recall 0.73. All variables are observed by D2 except the hidden good state, which the agent may infer. No future variables are used. Magnitude is largest on switch-to-a2 trials after an unrewarded a1 trial.
